name: OPERATION: IRON FRONT
description: Single-player open-world military game on the 12 km island of Varden, against AI. Campaign: VARDEN Chapter One, 6 missions (infantry, defence, night raids, tank assault, jet strike). Free Roam with squad, vehicles and sandbox tools. Battle: TDM, Domination, Conquest, King of the Hill, CTF, Sector Control, Survival. Bullet ballistics, inventory, day/night, weather, touch controls.

credits.work: All models, code and sound effects
